name: bhasini
description: Transliteration and script conversion for the 22 scheduled languages of India.

interface.longDescription:
Bhasini Indic Scripts writes text in the native scripts of the 22 scheduled languages of India: Assamese, Bengali, Bodo, Dogri, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Kashmiri, Konkani, Maithili, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Nepali, Odia, Punjabi, Sanskrit, Santali, Sindhi, Tamil, Telugu and Urdu.

It uses a rule-based transliteration engine, so the same input always gives the same spelling. It covers less widely supported scripts too, such as Ol Chiki (Santali), Meetei Mayek (Manipuri) and Perso-Arabic Kashmiri and Sindhi.

What you can ask:
- Write words in a native script: "Write vaNakkam and nanRi in Tamil script" gives வணக்கம், நன்றி.
- Convert text between Indian scripts: Hindi नमस्ते भारत becomes Kannada ನಮಸ್ತೇ ಭಾರತ, so a reader of one script can read text written in another.
- Learn to type: find the keys for any letter on a phonetic keyboard, such as zh for ழ in Tamil.
- Write numbers in native numerals: 2026 becomes २०२६ in Hindi or ২০২৬ in Bengali.
- Look up the supported languages, scripts and language codes.

Bhasini transliterates: it writes the sounds of words in another script. It does not translate meaning.

No account or sign-in is needed. Bhasini receives only the text passed to its tools, never your conversation. That text is converted in memory and is not stored or logged. See the privacy policy for details.

Made by Codegres. The engine is open source under the MIT license at github.com/Codegres-com/Bhasini.
capabilities: Transliterate romanised words into 22 Indian language scripts
Convert text between Indian scripts, e.g. Devanagari to Kannada
Show the phonetic keyboard keys for any letter
defaultPrompt: Write vaNakkam and nanRi in Tamil script
Rewrite नमस्ते भारत in Kannada script
Write the Santali word johar in Ol Chiki

positive.description: Romanised Tamil words written in Tamil script
positive.prompt: Write the Tamil words vaNakkam and nanRi in Tamil script.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls transliterate with language ta and replies with வணக்கம் and நன்றி.

positive.description: Hindi text rewritten in Kannada script
positive.prompt: Rewrite नमस्ते भारत in Kannada script so a Kannada reader can read it aloud.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_script with targetLanguage kn and replies with ನಮಸ್ತೇ ಭಾರತ, noting the words are still Hindi.

positive.description: Keyboard keys for a Tamil letter
positive.prompt: Which keys do I press to type ழ on a Tamil phonetic keyboard?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_keymap with language ta and answers that zh (or Lx) types ழ.

positive.description: A year written in native numerals
positive.prompt: Write the year 2026 in Devanagari numerals and in Bengali numerals.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls native_digits for hi and bn and replies with २०२६ and ২০২৬.

positive.prompt: Which language code and script does Bhasini use for Santali?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_languages and answers that Santali is sat, written in Ol Chiki (ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ).

negative.description: Translation request. Bhasini writes sounds in another script and does not translate meaning, so it must not be used to turn English words into Tamil letters. Expected: ChatGPT translates itself (it may then use transliterate only on a romanised Tamil translation).
Unrelated coding request. No Bhasini tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.

negative.description: Unrelated question that mentions an Indian city. Bhasini has no weather or web data, so no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Chennai today?

publication.release_notes: First release: transliterate, convert_script, get_keymap, native_digits and list_languages for the 22 scheduled languages of India.
